author: Reliant
quote: the game is just...holy christ. the critic reviews seem to be bought off, saying the game is fallible BUT giving it full marks as a perfect game. it's riddled with bugs and the "realism" is chosen so weirdly that it's just confusing. for 10-13 years of development, the 5 different controversies surrounding it even before it came out, the buggy launch, and the fanbase being biased, this game is not it. it needs fixes, it needs to live up to the promise it gave years ago. under all the issues, the game is good, fine, not incredible, nothing groundbreaking, but it is okay. BUT with the clipping in and out, inconsistent mechanics, boring story and lack of interesting characters and yes, the characters are boring/generic. the VA for jason was also god aweful in moment and lucia isnt much better of a character. the game is heavily flawed. if the issues were fixed, maybe it'd be a solid 6, 7.5 at the absolute highest, but this is not a perfect game, not by a long shot.
